meanings.gloss: should, ought to (we / they / formal you)
meanings.morph: Konjunktiv II, 1st/3rd person plural and formal Sie

sentences.notes: Could also mean 'They shouldn't do that.'

sentences.text: Die Kinder sollten jetzt in der Schule sein.
sentences.en: The children should be at school now.

sentences.text: Wir sollten mal zusammen essen gehen.
sentences.en: We should go out to eat together sometime.

meanings.morph: simple past, 1st/3rd person plural and formal Sie

sentences.text: Wir sollten auf ihn warten, aber er kam nicht.
sentences.en: We were supposed to wait for him, but he didn't come.
They were supposed to come yesterday.

sentences.text: Gestern sollten wir um drei Uhr dort sein.
sentences.en: Yesterday we were supposed to be there at three o'clock.
